sourceNotes.name: Labor Court ODR service
sourceNotes.usable_takeaway: Employment disputes can involve a structured pre-court path, including rights checks and a warning letter before labor-court action.
sourceNotes.draft_instruction: Keep employment copy as a dispute-specific subsection and avoid turning the labor page into a generic legal-letter page.

sourceNotes.name: Ministry of Labor work-rights complaint service
sourceNotes.usable_takeaway: A regulatory complaint is different from private civil relief; the page should not imply one letter replaces legal route selection.
sourceNotes.draft_instruction: Mention lawyer review only as fit-check help before escalation, not as a guaranteed remedy.

sourceNotes.name: Consumer Protection Authority complaint service
sourceNotes.usable_takeaway: Consumer complaints need transaction details, business details and supporting documents.
sourceNotes.draft_instruction: Consumer copy should ask for facts/evidence first and place any letter wording after refund/cancellation context.

sourceNotes.name: Small Claims Court filing service
sourceNotes.usable_takeaway: Small claims can cover goods, services, cancellation, tenancy and other disputes, and evidence preparation matters.
sourceNotes.draft_instruction: Use this as a boundary: demand-letter help may precede small claims, but the public page should not promise litigation results.

sourceNotes.name: Enforcement Authority eviction-cancellation service
sourceNotes.usable_takeaway: Eviction wording can sit in later enforcement stages, so public copy must distinguish warning/response from post-judgment eviction steps.
sourceNotes.draft_instruction: Keep rental-dispute demand-letter copy narrow and separated from lease-review copy and post-judgment enforcement content.

sourceNotes.name: Asaf Pelleg warning-letter guide
sourceNotes.usable_takeaway: Competitor pattern explains purpose, timing, risks and why lawyer review can prevent damaging wording.
sourceNotes.draft_instruction: Jus-Tice should match practical usefulness but keep the generic page blocked and split by dispute type.

sourceNotes.name: Yitzhak Goldstein warning-letter article
sourceNotes.usable_takeaway: Competitor pattern emphasizes scope and complexity differences across disputes.
sourceNotes.draft_instruction: Avoid fixed pricing or broad promises; ask owner to choose one narrow context first.
